messages:
Nora Simmons: Heads-up: invoice cutoff for monthly close moves to the 25th at 11:59 PM PT starting May 2026. Any invoices submitted after cutoff will be processed in the following month. Please plan vendor payments accordingly. Link: https://redwood.example.com/finance/invoice-cutoff

Diego Marquez: Thanks Nora. Does the cutoff change affect Net30 supplier terms or just our internal processing cadence?

Nora Simmons: Internal processing only. Supplier terms (Net30, Net45) remain unchanged. The cutoff only shifts when we run AP batches. If a vendor requires earlier payment, submit an expedite request and mark the vendor as "expedite-pay" in the portal.

FinanceBot: Automated note: expedite requests < $2,000 will be routed to Finance Lead for approval; >= $2,000 require Director approval + procurement confirmation.

Vendor Ops: Quick ask : for virtual card (vcard) charges, can teams still request one-off vcards for trial vendors after cutoff?

Nora Simmons: Yes, vcards can be issued anytime, but charges posted after cutoff will post to next month. To avoid vendor confusion, include the expected bill date in the vcard request and notify the vendor of the processing date.

Diego Marquez: Got it. Also, small ops note: please upload invoice PDFs with PO numbers in the filename (PO12345_invoice.pdf) to help matching. We'll reject files without PO references.

Nora Simmons: Good call. Final reminder: receipts and invoice uploads must be in the portal within 3 business days of charge for vcards, and within 7 days for corporate card charges. Late uploads will trigger a manual review and could delay reimbursement. Ping #finance if you need an exception.
